newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds set to reverse down to 100.48 area.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds set to reverse down to 100.48 area.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will fail at resistance around 100.88,92 on Thursday and slide down to test support first around 100.70, analysts said.

"We think we should see resistance tested at 100.88,92," said Martin Siegert, derivatives portfolio manager at Landesgirokasse in Stuttgart. "I don't think we will break this level and will see some more pressure on the downside."
Bunds were quoted at 100.78 at 0650 GMT, up two basis points from Wednesday's settlement.
Siegert said resistance on the topside came from a trendline on 60 minute charts tested over the last couple of days.
Bunds have also formed a top on daily charts at the 101.10 high on Monday. On Tuesday it only pushed as high as 100.92.
Siegert said failure to extend the upmove this week leaves the contract vulnerable to a decline.
He expected Bunds to push through initial support from Wednesday's low at 100.69 and the this week's range bottom at 100.65 to head towards pivot support at 100.47.
Longer term, he forecast a sharper decline into the 99.00 area, the neckline of a potential head-and-shoulders pattern.
Adrian Sells, director of Crane Investment Analysis in London, was more positive but said Bunds lacked dynamism.

"The short-term uptrend is in place," he said on Reuters Financial Television. He expected the contract to hold onto the 100.65 level but if it broke through there another buffer would come in around 100.20. Daily charts show this area as the bottom of the previous range.
He said however, the contract must puncture the 101.10 high to get a chance at the old May highs around 101.50.
At the short end, September Euromarks were quoted at 96.82 unchanged on the day in volume of 240,572 contracts. December Euromarks were also unchanged at 96.72, trading 256,106 lots at 0713 GMT.
